# Target schema columns and their types for reference
target_columns = ['anime_id', 'name', 'genre', 'type', 'episodes', 'rating', 'members']

# Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema and in the same order
    # If any source has extra or missing columns, this will raise an error
    df = df[target_columns]
    dfs.append(df)

# UNION operation: concatenate all source DataFrames vertically
result_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure data types match the target schema:
# 'anime_id': integer
result_df['anime_id'] = result_df['anime_id'].astype(int)
# 'name': string
result_df['name'] = result_df['name'].astype(str)
# 'genre': string
result_df['genre'] = result_df['genre'].astype(str)
# 'type': string
result_df['type'] = result_df['type'].astype(str)
# 'episodes': integer
result_df['episodes'] = result_df['episodes'].astype(int)
# 'rating': float
result_df['rating'] = result_df['rating'].astype(float)
# 'members': integer
result_df['members'] = result_df['members'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target CSV file path
result_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_77/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
